summary: Temporary danger area EGD494D for drone flights beyond visual line of sight at Hemlington, North Yorkshire, up to 400 ft above ground level.
text:
TEMPO DANGER AREA (TDA) EGD494D INSTALLED WI 1.61NM RADIUS OF
543103N 0011427W (HEMLINGTON, NORTH YORKSHIRE). BEYOND VISUAL LINE
OF SIGHT (BVLOS) UAS OPS CONTAINED WHOLLY WI THE TDA. MAX HGT
400FT AGL. EMERG SERVICES ACFT MAY ENTER THE AIRSPACE IN
ACCORDANCE WITH LOCAL DECONFLICTION AGREEMENTS. OPEN AND SPECIFIC 
CAT VISUAL LINE OF SIGHT (VLOS) UAS OPS ARE PERMITTED WI THE TDA 
WITHOUT PRIOR APPROVAL OR DECONFLICTION. OTHER NON-STANDARD FLIGHT, 
FLIGHT RESTRICTION ZONE OR CONTROLLED AIRSPACE APPROVALS MUST BE
OBTAINED. OPERATORS ARE REMINDED OF THEIR RESPONSIBILITY UNDER CAP722
5.2.2.3 REGARDING OPR IN CLOSE PROXIMITY TO AN EMERG RESPONSE 
EFFORT. FOR INFO AROPS(AT)CAA.CO.UK. DEC 24-JAN 03 CONTACT
DRONES(AT)CLEVELAND.POLICE.UKAR-2026-3799/06.
